title: Claude cleans up my messy Notion notes and writes them back in
description:
Claude connected to Notion reads your messy pages and rewrites them into a clean summary with a checklist, then updates the page in Notion itself. I show the whole flow on my phone: connect the Notion connector once, type one plain-English sentence, and Claude reads your Ideas page, reorganizes it, and writes it back so it's already done when you open the app. Full step by step guide + the exact prompt: https://vascoyaps.com/resources/notion-claude-connector
#ClaudeAI #Notion #Productivity #AITools #vascoyaps
